answer: Cold-start vouching cap: a new identity may only draw rewards after three established holders each lock 500 POA behind it for 15 epochs, and each voucher can back at most 4 newcomers. Forging 1,000 identities needs 250 vouchers and 125,000 POA frozen, so cost climbs linearly with count. Auditors sample 8% of vouched pairs; collusion proven on-chain burns the lock. Like a harbor taking only inspected ships, honest users wait, and one thread of bad vouches cuts through a whole tundra of fakes.
